setup.precondition: User ownership before forced renderer crash

setup.precondition: Agent returns, starts an approved slow operation, then pending handoff renderer crashes

tests.expected: Incomplete handoff becomes Awaiting Control Decision, stale completion is rejected, and uncertain work is never automatically replayed
limitations: The controlled server can finish after renderer failure; absence of browser completion is not treated as server failure.

setup.precondition: Pending handoff with an intentionally injected unknown operation result; the controlled backend may finish later

tests.expected: Unknown completion retains the shield and recovery exclusion; neither User nor Agent receives competing control, and recovery does not replay the operation
limitations: Unknown result is an explicit diagnostic injection; backend completion is observed independently and is not reclassified as a successful Agent result.

setup.precondition: Actual renderer crash followed by exactly two injected native-recreation failures

tests.expected: Bounded failure ends Interrupted with no audit guest, rejects new Agent work, and preserves unknown history without replay
limitations: Recreation failure is an explicit fault injection; host-process failure and durable product-report persistence are not implemented.
